title: Suspicious Kerberos Authentication After Failed Attempts
logsource:
  category: authentication
  product: windows
  service: security
  event_id: 4769
condition:
  selection:
    event_id: 4769
    account_name: '*svc_*'
  failed_attempts:
    timeframe: 5m
    count() by account_name >= 3
    filter:
      outcome: failure
  successful_after:

  condition: failed_attempts and successful_after
level: high

references:

arguments.summary: Malware (Trojan.GenericKD.48571234) was detected on endpoint 10.0.3.15 via behavioral analysis. The malware performed process injection into svchost.exe and initiated a C2 callback to internal IP 10.0.6.88 on port 8443. Both IPs were previously involved in Nmap SYN scans targeting 10.0.2.15. title: Suspicious Internal C2 Communication to High-Risk Port
logsource:
  category: network_connection
  product: firewall
conditions:
  - source_ip|cidr: '10.0.0.0/8'
  - destination_ip|cidr: '10.0.0.0/8'
  - destination_port: 8443
  - protocol: 'tcp'
level: high
references:
  - https://threatintel.corp.local/Trojan.GenericKD.48571234
falsepositives:
  - Legitimate internal TLS services on port 8443
author: SOC Team

rule Trojan_GenericKD_48571234_Mem_Injection {
    meta:
        description = "Detects in-memory code injection patterns associated with Trojan.GenericKD.48571234"
        malware = "Trojan.GenericKD.48571234"
        author = "SOC Team"
    strings:
        $inject_api = "ntqueryvirtualmemory" nocase
        $c2_domain = "dynamicdns[.]net" nocase
        $mutant = "Global\\kd_mutex_4857" nocase
    condition:
        any of ($inject_api, $c2_domain, $mutant)
}

rule Trojan_GenericKD_48571234_Mem_Injection {
